title: A bare code twin's item check runs on what it committed, as the kb code agent's runs on what landed
goal: twin_agent runs a bare code twin's item check on a checkout of its committed touched files, as kb_items_passed does for the kb code agent, so uncommitted files do not pass a twin's item

run:
import inspect, sys
sys.path.insert(0, '_tools')
import bench_multi
s = inspect.getsource(bench_multi.twin_agent)
assert 'item_passes(twin["spec"], twin["dir"]' not in s, 'a twin code item is checked in its whole working tree, uncommitted files included, while the kb agent is checked on the landed files'
